feature: Billing - the real artifacts/portal '/billing' page (src/pages/billing.tsx), part of #1598. Covers this build's own scope: Receipts (GET /api/portal/invoices, Git #1237) and 'Manage payment in Stripe' (POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal), wired via billingLive.ts, per Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/docs/portal/billing-contract-pack.md and the landed Billing.dc.html export. The landed design deliberately does NOT surface a live plan-state section (subscriptionsLive.ts / GET /portal/billing/subscriptions, Git #1611) on this page - its own logic states no tenant holds a monthly monitoring subscription today, so there is nothing real to show as a current plan; that endpoint stays real and unwired here, matching the design as shipped. Monitoring-plan tier cards are the design's own labeled illustration ('Illustrative, not your account'), not tenant data - not covered by apiTests. #4116 (2026-09-14) extends this manifest (tagged '4116') to cover the real invoice-revision surface: GET /api/portal/invoices now excludes status='superseded' (latest-version-only default, Shane's decision), a new GET /api/portal/invoices/:id/versions endpoint serves the real version-history chain + field diffs for the 'see what changed' affordance, and a new by-id route /billing/invoices/:id (src/pages/invoice-detail.tsx) renders it.
notes: #4112 (2026-09-14): added coverage for the MSP-console-proposed retainer interval switch (propose/approve/reject state machine, portal-retainer-billing.ts + msp-retainer-billing.ts). The approve/reject card on this page (retainerIntervalProposalLive.ts) is a real addition past the landed design - it is NOT the excluded hypothetical-repricing calculator noted below, since the customer only ever decides on a specific already-made proposal, never picks a target interval themselves. New apiTests below are tagged sessionTag '4112' - run with onlyTag when re-verifying just this addition. Re-run this manifest's '4112' tag via shaneapp://runTest once this branch reaches the dev-server checkout.

#3647 (2026-09-11): the 'Manage payment in Stripe' button is now also gated client-side on can("customer","billing.manage") - a presentation hint only, mirroring UserMenu.tsx's existing showBilling pattern. The real gate remains server-side (AUTH-GATE-2 below asks the identical customer:billing.manage, #3465); every holder of billing.view also holds billing.manage today so this hides nothing yet, and becomes real the moment a customer role is granted view without manage - which is exactly what #3629's new Billing role (see test-manifests/portal/team-role-assignment.json) is for. Not independently asserted by a dedicated apiTest here since it is a pure client-side render condition - the server-side boundary it mirrors is already covered by AUTH-GATE-2. The client-side render condition itself IS now driven, by UI2 below (Git #4104): billing-manage-payment rendering for the real signed-in Customer test profile is the live proof the grant resolved true.

WHAT THIS COVERS: both real reads/actions this page wires - GET /api/portal/invoices (Receipts) and POST /api/portal/billing/customer-portal (Manage payment in Stripe) - are auth-gated as documented, a logged-in customer gets the real payload shape billingLive.ts consumes, and a real UI walk confirms the page's always-rendered controls (billing-source / billing-manage-payment) actually mount for a signed-in customer.

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED (#2991, Feature #1648) - login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid, so this manifest drives a real login and asserts real rendered data-testids instead of only the pre-auth honest empty state (Git #4104 - this note previously said no login page existed yet; that premise was stale, the same correction test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json already made). billing-receipt-row/billing-download-<id> are NOT asserted here: they only render when the testbed account has at least one real invoice, which this manifest does not seed or assume - billing-manage-payment is gated on customer:billing.manage (canManageBilling, billing.tsx:143) rather than any invoice data, and the designated Customer test profile holds that grant (every existing billing.view holder retains billing.manage today, per the #3647 note above), so it is the real signed-in-render proof used here instead.

GET /api/portal/billing/customer-portal IS A POST that opens a real Stripe session - not exercised end-to-end here (it would open a live external redirect target for whichever account authenticates); the auth-gate (401 unauthenticated) is asserted, matching the same real-write caution account-security-data-rights.json documents for its own deletion-request POST.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).
